committee: Joint Health Insurance Affordability Task Force
location: Wyoming State Capitol W110 200 West 24th Street
title: The purpose of this meeting is to complete the Task Force's interim work. The Task Force will consider bill drafts related to a Wyoming medical device group purchasing organization and a Wyoming limited and catastrophic medical coverage pool. The Task Force will receive information regarding Western Interstate Commission for Higher Education (WICHE) funding, health insurance cost-sharing models, hospital price regulation concepts, all-payer claims databases, and primary care incentives.
